reports.title: FIRSTENERGY DELIVERS STRONG THIRD QUARTER RESULTS,

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: FirstEnergy reaffirmed its 2026 Core Earnings guidance range of $2.62 to $2.82 per share and expects results at or slightly above the midpoint.

Underpinning the company's growth is its five-year, $36 billion Energize365 capital investment, which will modernize the grid, renew distribution infrastructure and strengthen transmission reliability. In the first nine months of 2026, FirstEnergy deployed $4.9 billion to advance Energize365.

The long-term outlook continues to reflect a Core Earnings compound annual growth rate near the top end of the 6% to 8% range through 2030. Opportunities to support new generation and additional transmission investment have the potential to meaningfully increase the company’s investment and earnings growth profile.
